anonymous redactorial voice of this piska

props.gloss_en: the mishna: there are knots for which one is not liable as one is for the camel drivers' knot and the sailors' knot
the mishna: a woman ties the opening of her robe
[from 'not liable'] liability there is not -- but prohibition there is
the knots for which one is not liable -- which are they? the knot tied to the nose-ring
and the knot tied to the isterida
for the knot tied to the nose-ring, liability there is not
but prohibition there is [for the knot tied to the nose-ring]
for the knot tied to the isterida, liability there is not
but prohibition there is [for the knot tied to the isterida]
and there are [knots] permitted ab initio -- which are they? a woman ties the openings of her robe

supports.gloss_en: אמרת יש קשרין שאין חייבין עליהן -- חיובא הוא דליכא, הא איסורא איכא: 'not liable' implies there is a prohibition

objections.gloss_en: הא גופה קשיא: the opening clause implies prohibition, והדר תני קושרת אשה מפתח חלוקה -- אפילו לכתחילה! (internal contradiction in the mishna)

answered_by.gloss_en: הכי קאמר: there are knots one is not liable for -- the nose-ring-strap and isterida knots, patur but asur -- and there are knots permitted ab initio -- the robe's openings (= p_reisha_kitra_bizmama, p_reisha_kitra_beisterida, p_zmama_asur, p_isterida_asur, p_mifta_mutar_lechatchila)
